page.content:
Julio González-Pola (born 23 March 1916 and died 5 April 1974) was a Spanish racing driver. He attended the 1960 Argentine Grand Prix as a substitute driver for Ettore Chimeri, but his services were not required.

page.overview:
Who is Julio González-Pola?

Julio González-Pola (born 23 March 1916 and died 5 April 1974) was a Spanish racing driver. He attended the 1960 Argentine Grand Prix as a substitute driver for Ettore Chimeri, but his services were not required.
